preconditions.name: oracle_foraging_clears_floor
preconditions.description: The greedy nearest-resource ORACLE (capability_eval ceiling anchor, no agent) clears COMPETENCE_RESOURCE_FLOOR resources/episode in this exact env, proving the foraging floor is ACHIEVABLE. Same statistic as the load-bearing DV (env.step info transition_type=='resource'). Below-floor => the floor is not achievable here => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a reward-balance verdict.
preconditions.control: capability_eval greedy OraclePolicy, same ENV_KWARGS/seed, no agent

preconditions.name: control_reproduces_incompetence
preconditions.description: The A0 default-balance arm (724/728 all-ON balance) must forage BELOW the floor on a majority of seeds -- i.e. the 728 incompetence must reproduce -- for a reward-balance conclusion to be meaningful. If A0 already clears the floor the premise is not reproduced => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: A0 mean foraging_competence vs floor (majority of seeds)

preconditions.name: sufficient_eval_episodes_all_cells
preconditions.description: Every completed cell must log >= 5 eval episodes so foraging_competence is estimable. Below => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: min completed eval episodes across all cells
